title: aussiefy changes v4 draft 20261114-r1
description: Change/option out_span is a document replacement region. Nested part/riff spans and masks are local to their owner rendering; canonical part spans are local to card.text. All offsets are Unicode code points. Semantic rules are normative in docs/functional/changes.md.

warnings.description: Exactly list(Result.warnings), or list(DocumentResult.warnings) for a document; no client or service messages are added here.

withheld.description: Swaps and garnish whose renderings are withheld, the pick alone offered: a swap's other alternatives and locked options, a garnish's other alternatives and its removal. pick-differs where the pick, rendered over its region, isn't the output there; region-unsettled where a drawl or infix match still reads across the region's edge after widening.

warning_details.description: One detail per warning in the same order. Its message equals warnings[i]. Codes are engine diagnostics; services may filter these from reader-facing text.

span.description: Half-open Unicode code-point offsets. Order and bounds are semantic checks.

coined_by.description: Who coined this wording. Required and non-null for bulldust. Explicit coiner wins; otherwise agent is derived only from a bulldust assessment with produced_by agent.

produced_by.description: Who prepared the stored record, not generally who invented the wording. It implies agent coinage only when the evidence assessment is bulldust and no explicit coiner is recorded.

gloss.description: The family concept description: a plain-English explanation, independent of display names.

construction_card.description: construction_id is persistent for a given dictionary_id, independent of sampling and tuning; presence in any later request is not guaranteed. See README for its content identity algorithm.

mask.description: A maskable word in a rendering: its span in that rendering, where its kept ending starts (its end when it keeps none) and the vulgarity it needs.

removed.description: How a garnish's region reads without it: its words gone (and the word an opener lowered recased). Every garnish has one, but one named under withheld.

rule.description: The phonetic or swear-infix rule that made the change: its id, its kind, the level it starts at (min_level; null for an infix, which the vulgarity and the embellishment let in at any level), and the text before and after it.

source_match.description: Canonical key/root/qualifiers from detection_match. Cross-field root equality and dictionary membership are semantic checks.

part_occurrence.description: out_span is local to this owner's rendered (option) or output (change), like masks; never document coordinates. Join constructions[owner.construction_id].parts by the unique pair (role, ingredient_id).

riff_occurrence.description: out_span is local to the owner's rendered/output, like masks. riff_index indexes entries[entry_id].riffs within this response only; it is not a persistent selector or a replay guarantee.

oneOf.description: Key is entry_id ?? construction_id; it appears at most once across this change's alternatives and locked options, regardless of riffs. out_span is the document replacement region; nested part/riff spans are local to rendered.

tuning.description: Popularity requested and the number of distinct input preferences used by actual positive-weight candidates after repeat exclusions/variety. Includes eligible neutral weights and pools whose substitution roll failed; excludes counterfactual probes. Deduplicated across document units.

plain.description: Complete final reader-facing en-AU meaning name, not an internal ID or sentence template. Curatorial provisional status does not require client-side text completion.

differs.description: Reader-facing en-AU explanation of how the curated stand-in differs.
